content.short: Retrieves NFT metadata and transfer history for Ethereum and Solana.
content.description: Quicknode NFT API enables developers to quickly retrieve NFT metadata on Ethereum and Solana, including transfer history and rarity data, without digging through individual smart contracts. It also supports ownership verification, enabling token-gated access for services and platforms. With scalable RPC servers handling hundreds of billions of API requests, this API is designed to minimize latency when querying NFT data across supported chains.
